title: The candidate's remote pick passes over a url whose host cannot be read, so a mirror can take the candidate
body:
Found by CRITIC-4 on ST0011 WP02b-1 (its R3, probe p11): release_candidate_pick (lib/release.steps) passes over every url _release_url_named cannot read, its rc 3 included, a url with more than one @ before its host (an @ in its user part not written %40), so a remote on the repository's own host with such a url is never counted and a mirror on one other host is taken (origin https://u:p@ss@github.com/O/N beside https://gitlab.com/O/N picked the mirror at rc 0), where release_remote_naming refuses the same url; fix: the pick refuses a url it cannot read the host of, naming its remote, and docs/configuration.md's url sentence, which names such a url as passed over, says so. After the release, no work before it.

Resolution (cc, 2026-11-05 05:03Z by date -u): fixed at 42325d02aed691bd21e1175e820a690db15f63db, landed on main by devbin-vc's land-stack.sh from the tested tip 977798d5, its paths equal to it, unpushed until the 0.1.20 cut. release_candidate_pick (lib/release.steps) now refuses a push url whose host cannot be read, answering 4 and printing its remote alone, never the url, whose user part may hold a password. Its first pass reads each url in order until one names the repository on its own host, so such a url met before that stops the pick, and the pass on OWNER/NAME alone runs only once the first has read them all; a url naming no host or no OWNER/NAME is passed over as before. The cut's pre-flight refuses on 4, naming the remote, the repository and the remedy, writing the @ as %40, before anything is stamped, and docs/configuration.md's url sentence says so. Two releasecut.bats arms: the pick over origin's unreadable url beside a gitlab.com mirror answers origin at rc 4, and a cut whose origin has such a url stops at pre-flight with the refusal, never printing the password. Its run, under hv's localised-test rule of 2026-11-05, in slot 01M6N0K9N0107E1CRB23TSW8NX on devbin-vc's desk at 977798d5 on 2de6fa23: both arms red at the red clone ec99bbf2, main's code with the unit's releasecut.bats, each on its own property (the pick took the mirror at rc 0, and main's cut went past pre-flight and released with its candidate pushed to the mirror); releasecut.bats green at the tip under BSD, 172 ok of 172. The GNU legs, the tree scans, the whole suite and one critic pass run once, after every issue is closed.
